lines.text: David takes refuge in the cave of Adullam, and about four hundred distressed men rally around him.
David leaves his parents with the king of Moab, then the prophet Gad tells him to go into Judah.
Saul sits under the tamarisk tree at Ramah, and Doeg says he saw David come to Ahimelech at Nob.
Saul summons Ahimelech and spares him, but Doeg strikes down eighty-five priests at Saul's command after the guards refuse.

wrong_details.true: Saul says Ahimelech will surely die and orders the priests killed

lines.text: Abiathar escapes to David, and David tells him to stay with him and not be afraid.
